about: Live cases of the acting bench: the real models, in real time, on real camera pictures (run.py --models real). Each picture's things are labelled boxes in 1280x720 frame pixels; `on` a case names the picture its slide, board and running look come from. The requests are the user's own words from the live sessions of 2026-10-07 (leaf, on the 2026-06-14 footage) and 2026-10-10 (camera on the user, 20:30-20:34), and the user's journeys of 2026-10-11 (the plan's Slice 9, on the leaf: `leaf-*-journey-*`; researchers are a stand-in research process, never a model). Frozen with their scoring (run.py frozen()): change a case and earlier comparisons no longer compare. A case passes only when all its attempts pass.

Stomata and the squiggle as in leaf-012s.
